summary: Nautilus Biotechnology filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement covering an at-the-market (ATM) equity program of up to $125,000,000 of common stock under a September 11, 2026 sales agreement with TD Securities (TD Cowen) as sales agent or principal. Shares may be sold in negotiated transactions, block trades, or on Nasdaq by any Rule 415 method; TD Cowen receives up to 3.0% gross commissions. NAUT closed at $0.9721 on September 16, 2026. No price, premium, or closing date is fixed, no escrow applies, and proceeds are for general corporate purposes. Watch dilution pace, cash runway, and any sub-$1 Nasdaq compliance overhang.
